pattern_explanation: Turkish borrowed several words from French and other European languages, so many of them look like English words. Over time their meanings shifted, so the look-alike English word often has a different meaning.
false_friend_warning: Caution: one Turkish word on this card looks like the English word 'actual' but means 'current' or 'up-to-date'. Another looks like 'sympathetic' but means 'nice' or 'likeable', and another looks like 'pension' but means 'guesthouse'.
